section_title: Insuring Agreement — First-Party Ransomware & Extortion Response
text: The Insurer shall indemnify the Named Insured for Cyber Extortion Loss, Digital Forensics Incident Response fees, and Data Restoration expenses up to an Aggregate Limit of $5,000,000 subject to a per-occurrence Retention (Deductible) of $100,000 and an 18-hour Business Interruption Waiting Period.

section_title: Exclusion — Unpatched Critical CVE & Missing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
text: CRITICAL UNDERWRITING EXCLUSION: This Policy does not apply to any Claim or Extortion Loss arising out of unauthorized remote access through VPN, RDP, or Cloud IAM consoles where Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) was disabled, or where a CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) rated CVSS >= 9.0 remained unpatched for more than 30 calendar days prior to inception of the intrusion.

section_title: Social Engineering & Invoice Fraud Sublimit Endorsement
text: Notwithstanding the Aggregate Policy Limit, the Insurer's maximum liability for Deceptive Funds Transfer / Business Email Compromise (BEC) is strictly sub-limited to $250,000 per policy period, subject to a $25,000 deductible and mandatory out-of-band callback verification for bank account changes exceeding $50,000.

section_title: Condition Precedent — 72-Hour Breach Notification & Preservation of Logs
text: As a Condition Precedent to coverage, the Insured must notify the 24/7 Cyber Breach Hotline within 72 hours of discovery by the CISO or General Counsel and preserve immutable SIEM/EDR telemetry for at least 90 days.

section_title: All-Risk Direct Physical Loss & Machinery Breakdown Coverage
text: Covers direct physical loss or damage to Scheduled Manufacturing Facilities and Cold-Chain Warehouses up to $12,000,000 per occurrence, subject to a $150,000 base property deductible and a 48-hour Business Interruption Waiting Period.

section_title: Named Storm & Surface Flood Sublimit & Percentage Deductible
text: For perils of Named Windstorm, Hurricane, or Surface Flash Flood in Zone A/B, coverage is sub-limited to $2,500,000 in the annual aggregate and subject to a minimum deductible of $250,000 per location.

section_title: Exclusion — Gradual Corrosion, Wear & Tear, and Deferred Roof Maintenance
text: This Policy excludes loss or damage caused by gradual rust, oxidation, electrolysis, fungal rot, or rainwater intrusion through roof membranes that have exceeded their 20-year rated service life without documented recertification.

section_title: Protective Safeguards Warranty — Automatic Sprinkler & Fire Alarm (P-1/P-2)
text: Under Protective Safeguards Symbol P-1, the Insured warrants that the automatic wet-pipe fire sprinkler system is maintained in complete working order. Suspension or shut-off of water supply Valves for >8 hours without Fire Watch voids fire coverage.

section_title: Institute Cargo Clauses (A) — All Risks Transit & Reefer Breakdown
text: Covers physical loss or temperature excursion spoilage of biologic/pharmaceutical cargo in ISO reefer containers up to $3,000,000 per vessel conveyance, provided continuous IoT temperature data-logger telemetry confirms reefer power/compressor failure lasting >= 6 consecutive hours. Deductible: $50,000 per conveyance.

section_title: Exclusion — Inherent Vice, Improper Stowage & Insufficient Packaging
text: In no case shall this insurance cover loss, damage, or expense caused by insufficiency or unsuitability of packing, failure to pre-chill cargo prior to loading, or inherent vice of the subject-matter insured.

section_title: Executive Securities Class Action & Regulatory Defense Coverage
text: Pays Defense Costs and Settlements arising from Securities Claims and Derivative Demands up to $10,000,000 Aggregate Limit, subject to a Corporate Retention (Side B/C) of $500,000 and $0 retention for non-indemnifiable Side A claims.

section_title: Exclusion — Prior & Pending Litigation and Deliberate Fraud Adjudication
text: Excludes any Claim alleging deliberate criminal fraud, insider trading, or illegal personal profit established by a final, non-appealable judicial adjudication, or arising from facts noticed prior to the Continuity Date of January 1, 2025.

section_title: Specific Stop-Loss Reimbursement for High-Cost Inpatient & Oncology Care
text: Reimburses 100% of Eligible Inpatient Surgical, ICU, and FDA-approved Biologic/Oncology claims exceeding the Specific Deductible of $75,000 per covered member per plan year, up to an unlimited lifetime maximum, subject to Prior Authorization.

section_title: Exclusion — Off-Label Experimental Gene Therapy & Cosmetic Procedures
text: Excludes reimbursement for investigational Phase I/II clinical trial biologics, unapproved off-label cellular therapies lacking FDA/EMA indication, or elective cosmetic surgery.

section_title: Commercial Auto Physical Damage & Third-Party Bodily Injury Liability
text: Covers scheduled Class-8 tractors and trailers up to $1,500,000 Combined Single Limit (CSL) per accident with a $25,000 collision deductible, provided ELD and ADAS dashcam telematics are active at the time of loss.

section_title: Exclusion — Unlicensed Operator, DUI, or Disabled ELD Hours-of-Service Tampering
text: No coverage applies while any covered vehicle is operated by a driver with BAC >= 0.04%, a suspended CDL license, or where the Electronic Logging Device (ELD) was intentionally unplugged to falsify FMCSA Hours-of-Service limits.
